annotation.authors_or_issuer: Kim, J.-W.; Choi, Y.L.; Jeong, S.; Han, J.-H.
named_instruments_referenced: ALTAI (EU Assessment List for Trustworthy AI)
annotation.summary_en: Conference paper describing development of DORI, a home elderly-care service robot, applying five requirements of Korea's voluntary AI Ethics Self-Checklist (35 items across 10 requirements). It introduces the checklist and shows how ethical requirements shape robot functions; detailed checklists and user experiments are future work.
key_provisions_or_claims: Korean AI Ethics Self-Checklist has 35 items across 10 core requirements, voluntary and non-binding
Checklist implements three principles: human dignity, social common good, purposefulness of technology
Home care robot DORI built on MISoRo applies five ethical requirements
Robot warns users of inappropriate behavior and handles medication reminders with face recognition
Future work: detailed checklists and user experiments for validation
annotation.title_clean: Development of Artificial Intelligence Service Robot According to the Korean Ethical Self-Checklist
annotation.title_en: Development of Artificial Intelligence Service Robot According to the Korean Ethical Self-Checklist
annotation.venue: ICRES 2022: 7th International Conference on Robot Ethics and Standards
